inline_text:
@hymkw, the cases I promised in [issue 18](https://github.com/aaif/wg-identity-and-trust/issues/18) are in the test-cases/delegation-lifecycle directory, now with a recovery set for your lost-key question.

The tree and re-registration sets come from agent-evidence-vectors release v0.19.0, and the tree set follows your case 8 in [message 30](https://lists.aaif.io/g/wg-identity-trust/message/30).

A recovery record signed by the registry and the Responsible entity, matched on software attestation, carries revocations and disputes forward, never a grant. The cases are recovery-regrant, recovery-grant-not-carried, recovery-registry-only, recovery-software-mismatch, recovery-after-compromise-no-revival, recovery-after-compromise-regrant and recovery-history-follows. The recovery job runs them from agent-evidence-vectors v0.20.0 without copying them, and [INDEX.md at that release](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-vectors/blob/v0.20.0/vectors-delegation-lifecycle/INDEX.md#recovery-after-a-lost-or-compromised-key) states each rule and marks those without precedent Proposed.

Would you check whether the recovery rules match what use case B needs?

Edited 2026-10-18: added the recovery set and its job at release v0.20.0; the tree and re-registration cases moved from commit aeac3739 to release v0.19.0.
